name: Band Pull-Through
steps: Anchor a resistance band low behind you, step straddling it facing away, grasp the band between your thighs, and walk forward until taut.
Soften your knees slightly, keep your arms straight, and brace your core with a flat back.
Hinge your hips smoothly backward toward the anchor until you feel a clear stretch through your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forcefully forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall with straight arms.
tips: Keep your arms straight like ropes so your hips rather than your shoulders power the movement.
Finish tall by squeezing your glutes without leaning backward at the top.
